issues.detail: The claimed eight-page 2022 French technical-data asset now returns 404 and the retained locator resolves to landing HTML, not the PDF. Its transcriptions are unresolved reference notes and cannot constrain the US package, selected tires, track centers, wheelbase, ground clearance, suspension-cylinder size, PTO modes, or public envelope.

The current US page proves an optional 3500 kg front three-point lift capacity. This package does not publish a Category 3N fact; its visible front linkage class, pivots, links, coupler and fold presentation are selected reconstructed visualization choices.
Only the hash-bound current US page controls retained performance and linkage-capacity facts. The rejected French locator contributes no geometry or configuration authority.
One US bullet says 70 mph, conflicting with repeated official 43 mph and 70 km/h statements. This package uses 70 km/h.
Suspension pivots, ride-height response, steering linkage, hitch anchors, PTO shaft detail, damping, and all collision limits remain reconstructed.
